title: Everest recordings and a planned Ebony Concerto revival in Holland
summary: For Everest the band redid Summer Sequence and Ebony Concerto; Herman hopes to perform Ebony Concerto at a 1980 Stravinsky festival, possibly with Buddy DeFranco.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: I see. Now, you were then under contract with Everest Records?
Yeah, we had a (inaudible) with them, yes. And we did some interesting things. We redid 'Summer Sequence.'

And speaking of 'Ebony Concerto,' I think you might be interested in this. They've asked me to see if we can't perform it at a Stravinsky festival in Holland in 1980, and I said that I would certainly like to do it, but that I
would probably prevail on someone like Buddy DeFranco to play the clarinet solo, because I don't have the time to prepare for it, and it would take a lot of time at my stage of the game.
But I think we'll do it.
Well, that's right. That'll be a wonderful experience and contribution.
I just thought I'd throw that in.
Yeah, it's a good one, it's a good one. You haven't talked to Buddy about it, have you?

I haven't yet, because this happened only a month ago and I only spoke to the man who's in charge. And he was at an engagement -- I played in Holland and he was so impressed with the group and so on, and he asked -- he knew -- he had heard about the Stravinsky piece.
